PRIVACY POLICY
Your privacy on CargoKit and yamlogistics.com
Last updated: 8 November 2026. This policy covers the CargoKit app for Android, the websites cargokit.ai, cargokit.app, cargokit.in and yamlogistics.com, and the free tools on them. They are run by
YAM Logistics Private Limited
(CIN U74899DL1987PTC027852), New Delhi, India.
The short version
There is no account, no sign-up and no advertising.
We do not use analytics or tracking tools, and we do not sell or share personal data.
The load planner, CBM calculator, label tools, checkers and calculators work on your phone or computer. Your cargo details and the documents you check stay on your device.
A few live tools ask the internet for fresh data (exchange rates, vessel positions, trade notices). What they send is described below.
We receive personal details only when you choose to send them to us, for example by uploading an MSDS for review, turning on shipment alerts, or contacting us on WhatsApp, Telegram or email.
1. Information that stays on your device

The calculations in our tools run inside the app or your browser. This includes the cargo lists, dimensions and weights you type into the container load planner, the PDFs and loading videos it creates, CBM and duty calculations, and the invoices, packing lists, bills of lading or airway bills you open in the document checker. These are not uploaded to us.
To work well, the app keeps a few small items on your device:
your language choice (a cookie named
, kept for one year);
your recent tracking searches, so you can repeat them quickly;
the results you choose to save, your
My shipments
list (numbers, labels, ETAs and notes), and the details you type into the invoice and packing list maker and its checklist, so you do not have to enter them again;
small notes that you have already seen a notice, cleared when you close the app;
offline copies of our pages and tools, so they work without signal.
You can remove all of these by clearing the app’s storage in Android settings (Settings › Apps › CargoKit › Storage), or by clearing site data in your browser.
2. Information sent when you use live tools
Pages and files.

When the app or site loads a page, your device connects to our hosting provider, Cloudflare. As with any website, this connection includes your IP address, browser type, the page requested and the time. Cloudflare processes this to deliver and protect the site, under its own privacy policy.
Shipment tracking.

When you search a vessel name, container number or airway bill, that search text is sent to our server so it can look up public vessel information. We do not attach your name or contact details to it and we do not keep a record of who searched. Links to carriers’ and airlines’ own tracking pages open their websites, which have their own privacy policies.
Exchange rates and trade updates.

The duty calculator and export benefit finder fetch current exchange rates from our server and from public rate services (frankfurter.dev and open.er-api.com). The Trade Desk fetches public news and government notices. These requests contain no personal information beyond the normal connection details above.
Shipment alerts.
Only if you turn them on. See section 3.
Fonts.
Some pages load fonts from Google Fonts, which receives normal connection details.
3. Information you choose to send us
MSDS upload (DG cargo checker).

If you ask us to review a Material Safety Data Sheet, you send us the file together with your name and email address and, if you wish, your company, phone number and HS code. We store these securely to answer your request and to follow up about that shipment. We accept the upload only after you tick the consent box.
Shipment alerts (optional).

If you turn on alerts in My shipments, you give us your email address or WhatsApp number, and we confirm it with a one-time code. We then store that contact together with the shipment numbers, labels and ETA dates in your list, in access-controlled storage. We use them only to send you reminders before and after your ETA. Emails are sent through our email provider (Resend) and WhatsApp messages through Meta’s WhatsApp Business Platform, which handle your address or number to deliver the message under their own privacy policies. You can stop at any time by tapping
Stop
in the app or the unsubscribe link in any email, and we then delete your contact and shipment details. If you never turn alerts on, none of this is sent to us.
WhatsApp, Telegram and email.
If you contact us through these, the message is handled by that service and by our team. We use your details only to reply and to provide the logistics service you ask about.

We keep information you send us for as long as needed to serve you and to meet the legal and record-keeping obligations of a licensed customs broker in India. You can ask us to delete it at any time (see section 7).
4. App permissions

The CargoKit Android app does not ask for your location, contacts, microphone or phone permissions. When you choose a file in the document checker or the MSDS upload, or take a photo to read a container number, Android’s own file picker or camera app gives us only the file you select. A container number photo is read on your device and is not uploaded. Reports and videos you download are saved to your device’s Downloads folder.
5. Sharing and sale of data

We do not sell personal data and we do not share it with advertisers. We share information only with the service providers needed to run the app and site (such as Cloudflare for hosting and storage, Resend for alert emails and Meta for WhatsApp alerts), when the law requires it, or when you ask us to (for example, passing your shipment details to a carrier to book your cargo).
6. Children
CargoKit is a professional tool for the shipping and trade industry. It is not aimed at children, and we do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 18.
7. Your choices and rights

You can use every free tool without giving us any personal details. If you have sent us personal information, you can ask to see, correct or delete it, and you can withdraw your consent (for alerts, tap Stop), in line with India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Write to
info@yamlogistics.com
with the subject “Privacy” and we will reply within 30 days.
8. Security
Our sites and app use encrypted HTTPS connections. Files and records you send us are kept in access-controlled storage that only our team can reach.
9. Changes to this policy
If we change how we handle information, we will update this page and the date at the top. Significant changes will also be noted in the app.
